name: fresh-review
description: Code review with enforced producer/reviewer context separation. Runs the lattice review and the gstack security audit against one shared diff packet via context-isolated subagents, then triages the findings back in the producer context and logs the run. An opt-in background cross-model Codex pass runs only when the invocation asks for it (--codex). A second mode reviews a PR — yours or someone else's, by number or URL — and adds a diagram-first account of what the change does (a Mermaid sequence/flow diagram in the repo's own DDD vocabulary, drawn from the code alone so it can contradict the PR description), a low/med/high risk classification of the change, and a one-line note when the change touches frontend UI (it does not launch or screenshot the app). Skips gstack's /review on your own branch — /ship runs that on the final diff — and ships a dispatch gate that trims the parts of ship's own review army this run already covered; the exception is pr-remote (reviewing someone else's PR), where no ship of yours runs, so it runs /review report-only as a pass to cover the structural specialists and Red Team.
